name: Elective Action Order
description: An alternative initiative system for Roll20 ("Elective Action Order" / "Popcorn Initiative"): whoever has the current turn designates who acts next. Extends the Roll20 turn order tracker and provides a chat interface for the players and GM. Supports both the "D&D 5E by Roll20" (2014) and the "D&D 2024 by Roll20" character sheets; the 2024 sheet requires the Experimental API sandbox.
